data.gender_notes: Grija is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'grih' meaning house or dwelling. The name Grija represents a lady or wife. In Hindu mythology, Griha is also the name of a goddess, the wife of the god Indra. The name Grija carries the meaning “Lady, Wife” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Grija usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, wife and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of marital bliss and commitment.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Grija total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
